observed_gap: complete_authenticated_reentry() does not receive/revalidate the ExternalMonotonicProvider or assert that the stored provider receipt/root is still the current monotonic head at re-entry time.
complete_authenticated_reentry() verifies signed authority against the caller-supplied signer_trust_snapshot but does not assert root.trust_snapshot_id equals the verified signer trust snapshot id.

Current V03 tests cover rollback during establish_replacement_clock_epoch(), stale Mission, and revoked old signer epoch, but do not cover provider-head advancement followed by stale-root re-entry or root/signer-trust-snapshot mismatch.

clock_key_epoch is a receipt-bound identifier, but V03 does not cryptographically bind that identifier to an explicit clock-secret fingerprint; this remains a provenance claim gap even inside the synthetic shadow boundary.
risk: A stale/replayed clock epoch root or a root established under one trust-snapshot label may be accepted for re-entry with another otherwise-valid signer trust snapshot because freshness and trust-root identity are not rechecked at the final re-entry gate. This can weaken the intended monotonic rollback boundary before terminal-exit work begins.
required_repairs_before_release: Re-entry must revalidate the exact ClockEpochRoot against the current ExternalMonotonicProvider head/binding/receipt, or consume a fresh provider-attested continuation receipt that cryptographically binds the root fingerprint and re-entry decision.
Re-entry must verify signer_trust_snapshot and require its canonical snapshot_id to equal root.trust_snapshot_id before accepting AuthorityDecisionEnvelope.
Bind clock_key_epoch to a typed/fingerprinted key identity in the synthetic protocol, or explicitly downgrade the field to non-security metadata and prevent it from being used as trust evidence.
required_regressions: provider head advances after root establishment -> stale root re-entry must fail closed
root.trust_snapshot_id differs from verified signer trust snapshot id -> re-entry must fail closed
same Mission blob + valid authority signature must not bypass either mismatch
clock_key_epoch/key fingerprint mismatch must fail closed if epoch identity is security-relevant

routing.W03: Review this finding against SPIRIT-MOD-GB21-045 and decide whether it keeps the non-terminal recovery veto open or partially released.
routing.W04: Treat current V03 as TEST_REQUIRED/BOUNDED_VETO until W02 repairs and executable evidence covers the re-entry trust-root boundary.
routing.W02: Repair this before or as the first inseparable part of the terminal-exit tranche; do not advance to terminal-exit while stale-root re-entry remains possible.
